title: Kings Way Lake View | KEY.co
description_expanded: Downstairs, four well-appointed bedrooms three with lake views offer peaceful privacy, while the expansive primary suite is a true sanctuary with its own fireplace and floor-to-ceiling windows. A spacious game room invites hours of fun with foosball, pool, and another large-screen TV, while two sleeper sofas provide added flexibility for larger groups. Outside, a private hot tub and seasonal gas BBQ set the stage for effortless outdoor living. With the Tahoe Rim Trail at your doorstep, world-class skiing at Northstar just 15 minutes away, and the vibrant shops, dining, and lake access of Kings Beach minutes from home, this property is the perfect blend of luxury, adventure, and tranquility. Perched on a half-acre of pristine forestland with sweeping views of Lake Tahoe, this elegant mountain retreat brings the outdoors in with wall-to-wall windows and sun-drenched living spaces. Designed for connection and comfort, the home features a chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances, sleek new countertops, and a six-burner gas range all perfectly positioned for entertaining with ease. Adjacent living rooms, each with a fireplace and oversized smart TV, offer cozy spaces to gather after a day on the lake or trails. From sunrise coffee on the deck to golden hour by the fire, every moment is framed by breathtaking natural beauty.
